gloss: to insist (stubbornly); to assert firmly; to maintain

definitions.gloss: to insist (stubbornly); to assert firmly; to maintain (one's claim)
definitions.explanation: To stubbornly hold to and keep asserting one's own opinion or claim, refusing to back down even when challenged. Often carries a nuance of unreasonable stubbornness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{張|は}る。
examples.english: He insists he did nothing wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{張|は}った。
examples.english: She insisted that she knew nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{張|は}って⟦{譲|ゆず}らなかった→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧。
examples.english: Even when shown the evidence, he kept insisting he was right and would not give in.

notes:
To keep firmly asserting one's claim and refuse to yield, often with a connotation of obstinacy. Typically takes a quoted statement marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{張|は}る: to insist that ～
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{言|い}い{張|は}る: to keep insisting to the end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧: to assert — neutral; states one's position without the stubborn nuance
- {言|い}い{張|は}る: stresses refusing to back down
